steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each improvement is matched to its result. A target missed with no action is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Target missed by more than 10 percent with no action
findings.fix: Set the action for the quarter

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] imp-setup-3.md:12  Target missed by more than 10 percent with no action.
       Fix: Set the action for the quarter.
[medium] imp-scrap-2.md:19  Improvement with no result.
       Fix: Record the result.
[low] next-q-1.md:26  Next-quarter improvement with no measure.
       Fix: Add a measure.
Not checked: Improvements not recorded.
pros: Checks an improvement with no result, a target missed by more than 10 percent with no action, and a next-quarter improvement with no measure.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-line-improvement-review skill on the records for this review.
